name: Granting of Czech Citizenship (Naturalisation)

requirements.blocker_text: Must hold a permanent residence permit and have resided in Czechia for an uninterrupted period of at least 5 years (Section 14(1)(a)).
Must prove knowledge of the Czech language (Section 14(4)).
requirements.fix_path: Pass the required Czech language test.

requirements.blocker_text: Must not have been found guilty of a negligent crime resulting in imprisonment, or found guilty of an intentional crime (Section 14(3)(a)).
Must prove income and its source for the 3 years preceding the application (Section 14(7)).
Must demonstrate integration into Czech society, particularly through a family or work environment (Section 13(1)).

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 years of permanent residence
3 years of income and income-source documentation

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs -- Act No. 186/2013 Coll. on Citizenship of the Czech Republic: Sections 13-14, naturalisation residence/language/character/income/integration requirements

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Czechia's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1 from the primary legislation's own English translation. Requires holding cz_permanent_residence (itself requiring 5 years of prior temporary residence) for a further 5 years before naturalisation eligibility -- meaning the realistic minimum timeline from initial arrival to citizenship is longer than the 5-year figures alone suggest, since the two 5-year clocks (temporary-to-permanent, then permanent-to-citizenship) are sequential, not overlapping, per the sources reviewed. dual_citizenship_allowed set true: the 2014 Citizenship Act reform removed the prior renunciation requirement, permitting dual citizenship generally.
